title: worldmapframe
summary: Program.WorldMap.cs shows the fullscreen map on the M binding: full-screen blackout, fullscreen scale-to-fit law, the 12-piece UI-WorldMap parchment chrome, the 12 continent/zone detail tiles from WorldMapArea directories, current-zone/continent resolution from the player's area, a player position blip, zone-name label, Zoom Out / Current Zone toggle, close X. Navigation and discovery features of the ref/Benilla are absent.

openItems.text: No click-to-navigate (ProcessMapClick): a continent view's zones cannot be clicked into, and arbitrary zones cannot be viewed - only own-zone <-> own-continent toggling
No exploration/discovery overlays (explored sub-areas painting their detail over the base parchment)
No hovered-area highlight (ADD-blend zone highlight) and no hovered-area label pair
Player blip is a plain circle with no facing (Benilla spins MinimapArrow art by GetPlayerFacing)
